verdict.rationale: Marqeta exposes an extensively documented Core API (cards, users, controls, transactions, disputes, webhooks) with an interactive sandbox and browser-testable widgets, enabling programmatic/agentic drive of the product; it even ships an official MCP server for AI agents to query and act on API endpoints. Missing for 10: publicly discoverable machine-readable spec files (openapi.json, llms.txt) which probes show return 404, so automated agent discovery of the API schema is not directly confirmed.
